## Problem 1

Prose goes here. Inline math works: $\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}$.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.title("sin(x)")
plt.show()
```

The plot above shows one period of $\sin(x)$.
